SELECT p.id AS pointId, p.point_code AS pointCode, p.point_name AS pointName, p.zone AS zone, p.zone_name AS zoneName, p.segment_name AS segmentName, p.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, p.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, p.camera_config_id AS cameraConfigId, p.camera_code AS cameraCode, p.camera_name AS cameraName, p.camera_id AS platformCameraId, p.device_status AS deviceStatus, p.alarm_status AS alarmStatus, p.defense_status AS defenseStatus, to_char(p.last_heartbeat_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS lastHeartbeatAt, to_char(p.latest_event_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS latestEventAt, p.sort_no AS sortNo FROM ai_perimeter_monitor_point p
AND p.warehouse_id IN
#{wid}
AND 1 = 0
AND p.enabled = TRUE
ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC

SELECT FROM ai_perimeter_event e
ORDER BY e.occurred_at ASC
ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC

ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS recordId, r.status_before AS statusBefore, r.status_after AS statusAfter, r.process_result AS processResult, r.process_opinion AS processOpinion, r.processed_by AS processedBy, to_char(r.processed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS processedAt, r.source AS source FROM ai_perimeter_process_record r WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY r.processed_at ASC
